title: st-eve-2508-free
rationale: IIIX reverses dissolution only after each member re-authors a reason to continue; fran forces miho to confront her own failure to publicly preserve Yō, directly entering the Tier-A deferred memory question.

title: st-eve-2507-free
rationale: IIIX US arc dismantles each member's inherited reason to continue: kana finds her father, fran receives investment pressure, and miho watches Yō erased from public narrative before the unit chooses dissolution.

title: PRIDE貫く頂点への道標
rationale: Sunny voluntarily seeks DoriKyun pressure; DoriKyun finally articulates an anti-exploitation industry mission and recognizes Sunny as genuine, materially revising the antagonist/mentor ledger.

title: Happy Smile Selfie
rationale: IIIX immediately after Hoshimi transfer confronts reduced agency privilege, reputational damage and new institutional dependence while insisting the unit remains self-authored.

title: 星々が奇跡と叶える約束の未来
rationale: Mana/Haruko/Saegusa institutional history and the unfulfilled duet promise are inherited by the next generation, making Hoshimi continuity concrete rather than metaphorical.

title: すれ違いのディソナンス
rationale: LizNoir clashes over an external producer who asks them to trade recognizability for growth; the arc ends on the unresolved question of what may be sacrificed for the top.

title: 欺瞞の最強TWINkle
rationale: Kokoro and kana manufacture a convincing friendship persona for work while school/career strain and kana's father-motive expose the cost and utility of performed authenticity.

title: 翔けぬけるVictoire　誓いのplume
rationale: TRINITYAiLE responds to one loss with a 99-win safety strategy; fan evidence shows the loss was more memorable than the wins, directly attacking metric sovereignty.

title: 君を照らすムーンライトロード
rationale: Immediately before the DoriKyun decision, Tsuki survives public hostility and encounters idols for whom defeat means either retirement or renewed continuation; loss is shown to have different moral qualities.

title: 煌めく奇跡をもう一度
rationale: Mana birthday ritual binds Makino dream-memory, local public memory, private grief, and annual commemoration; direct test of supernatural ambiguity and Hoshimi memory institution.

title: 遥か頂に向かう秀麗
rationale: Rei overtrains toward the top; Haruko forfeits a live rather than permit bodily risk, providing a direct counter-model for Sakura/Makino health-autonomy tensions.

title: お待たせしました里帰り～星見凱旋記～
rationale: Hoshimi homecoming overlays Mana/Haruko/Makino local history with the current multi-unit institution, making place-based public memory part of professional continuity.

title: 偽りのREALISM ～密着 新曲会議！？～
rationale: IIIX turns documentary exposure, center conflict and deliberate public friction into creative material, directly testing authenticity under managed media.

title: ぶつかり愛のCenter Battle！
rationale: All five Tsuki members contest center by performance; Nagisa wins, proving BIG4's contestable-center principle generalizes beyond Kotono/Suzu and that losing can deepen rather than erase agency.

title: あなたに捧ぐWith your songs
rationale: Kotono and Suzu build an answer song around Mana while testimony splits sister, idol, rival and vulnerable person; Sakura again experiences embodied presence without proving supernatural causality.

title: 運命繋ぐ流星の軌跡
rationale: Rio explicitly abandons the idea that moving forward requires forgetting Mana; public cover performance converts memory from obstacle into competitive continuity.

title: 不屈のChallenger～Roll the dice～
rationale: IIIX tests overseas expansion while preserving Hoshimi affiliation, making global ambition and contractual autonomy concrete.

title: 羽ばたけ！恩返しのAile
rationale: TRINITYAiLE reframes gratitude as repeatable practice rather than debt and uses DoriKyun/Makino relationships to show repayment continuing after achievement.

title: 心愛溶けるビターチョコレート
rationale: Kokoro turns accidental past harm into private atonement; LizNoir rejects guilt as a legitimate basis for future labor and redirects her toward self-authored contribution.

title: 並び立つ歌姫のフルリール
rationale: Shizuku/Rui collaboration tests mentorship, consent, self-confidence and rival-unit equality; Rui explicitly recognizes the arrogance of imposing her own correct method.

title: 新春万福　素顔の晒し合いGAME
rationale: IIIX official video channel deliberately commodifies the members' unguarded selves, making the boundary between genuine friction and produced authenticity newly explicit.

title: 夢踊るステージに架け橋を
rationale: Rei and her father directly debate whether idol labor is socially meaningful, sustainable, and worth a life; unusually strong family-versus-vocation evidence.

title: 最高優美＊飛躍のカウントダウン
rationale: Rio absence forces Kokoro to occupy center and LizNoir to prove resilience; center is treated as earned responsibility rather than immutable ownership.

title: 音色の輝石が紡ぐ未来
rationale: Sunny/Tsuki rivalry reveals the pressure of comparative distance and Kotono-style result fixation, useful as a precursor to BIG4 rather than an endpoint revision.

title: おしごとシークレット
rationale: Yu hides a family-linked doujin vocation while balancing idol work; the reveal reframes elite professionalism as compatible with a private creative life and paternal support.

title: 笑顔のSUNNY 繋げるPEACE
rationale: Sunny national tour literalizes reciprocal audience connection across regions, including fans whose lives and aspirations are changed by the unit.

title: 開演！ぷりてぃー★エンジェル
rationale: Yu confronts acting lineage and her mother, clarifying inherited talent, persona, refusal and family-professional negotiation.

title: 羽休む聖夜のサプライズ
rationale: Rui holiday loneliness and TRINITYAiLE care expose private dependency beneath elite professionalism and add needed pre-Stellar Rui relational evidence.

title: 星見プロ全国ツアー　Stars Journey
rationale: Hoshimi national tour tests multi-unit institutional identity outside Tokyo and provides broad social/managerial continuity evidence.

title: IDOLY MATCH～地下闘技場への挑戦～
rationale: Underground IDOLY MATCH expands the competitive ecosystem beyond polished agencies and tests what counts as idol professionalism at the industry margins.

title: 旗揚げ！劇団★見～二人のアリスとWONDERLAND～
rationale: Stage-play work makes self-expression, casting and acting-as-persona explicit across units, useful for authenticity synthesis.

title: 私達の青春謳歌～DOTABATA SCHOOL FESTIVAL～
rationale: School-festival material tests Yu and other student idols across public work and ordinary school identities, valuable for labor/social-boundary synthesis.

title: 芽吹く黒ユリの蕾
rationale: Ai confronts inferiority inside LizNoir and learns that emotional intensity must be disciplined without erasing individuality; strong undercovered LizNoir internal evidence.

title: 心紡ぎ合う輝きの競演
rationale: Chisa/Saki limited unit turns sisterhood into chosen artistic collaboration and tests identity outside their default units.

title: 迷走ピリオド 涼やかな青春
rationale: Mei/Suzu limited unit turns contrasting styles into reciprocal challenge and broadens how Tsuki members can author performance outside default roles.

title: let's 湯けむり dancing！
rationale: Aoi accepts authorship pressure for a LizNoir song, then recovers creativity through the unit and concludes that LizNoir style is produced by each member being themselves rather than by a fixed formula.

title: 愛歌う星の継承者
rationale: Mana-song inheritance through Suzu/Mei/Kotono/Rio adds person-versus-legend texture but substantially overlaps the already frozen inheritance architecture.

title: 舌戦開幕！賛美の湯
rationale: IIIX praise-game/onsen material gives unusually dense hostile-intimacy evidence but mostly stabilizes a relational grammar established elsewhere.

title: 君と願う月灯の祝祭
rationale: Kotono birthday/Christmas ritual links Mana-era memory to the four members explicitly affirming her existence and shared history; this is material grief-personhood maturation, not mere seasonal texture.

title: 灼熱のBEACH ～イライラMAX ⅢX～
rationale: IIIX beach conflict confirms hostile intimacy as durable creative/professional structure, with moderate rather than transformative delta.

title: 漕ぎ出せ！アイドル★サバイバーズ
rationale: Chisa confronts a childhood drowning fear and her habit of declaring herself expendable; supported safeguards let her articulate a positive want to remain with the group, materially extending self-authorship under dependence.

title: 迎春！翼に込める躍進の一念
rationale: TRINITYAiLE television challenges expose grit, health management and elite-image flexibility, useful but secondary to stronger score/gratitude events.

title: ぱじゃまパーティー！～夢見る少女と眠り姫～
rationale: Sumire-led cross-unit mini-unit gives strong self-definition and peer-recognition evidence outside TRINITYAiLE, though it does not materially revise the main spine.

title: 守れ！純潔のベーゼ～imposition of love～
rationale: Rui commercial kiss/CM pressure tests public persona, boundaries and group protection, but with limited longitudinal state change.

title: 感謝を伝えるLovely Valentine's Day
rationale: Sunny gratitude toward Makino/Hoshimi helps specify manager-idol reciprocity but largely confirms the established co-authorship model.

title: 雨上がりの太陽と共に
rationale: Haruko-centered summer work revisits veteran insecurity and professional continuity, but mostly extends rather than revises the Tier-A model.

title: 導きのファンファーレ
rationale: Sunny collaborative songwriting and fan encounters reinforce audience reciprocity with modest new state change.

title: 熱中☆ハプニングサマー
rationale: Four-person LizNoir leisure material is valuable for domestic/professional social rhythm but low in main-model revision pressure.

title: 昇る初陽に咲く笑顔
rationale: Sunny gratitude and Sakura family life stabilize reciprocal-care motifs with limited contradiction potential.

title: 未来とつながるマジカルメロディ
rationale: TRINITYAiLE/Miku collaboration offers audience and performance-persona evidence, but crossover premises constrain series-native inference.

title: 君と輝くサンシャイン!!
rationale: Love Live Sunshine collaboration contains useful Sunny social texture but external crossover premises sharply limit longitudinal inference.

title: 未来を彩るスノーフェスティバル
rationale: LizNoir/Miku snow-festival material adds performance gratitude but is crossover-dependent and redundant with stronger native evidence.

title: 未来へ続く夏祭り
rationale: Miku/Tsuki summer event has useful social texture but crossover dependence and low unique state change.

title: 月夜に輝く恋の魔法
rationale: Tsuki summer/new-song social texture and Mei relational material; useful voice evidence but little Tier-A revision pressure.

title: にゃんか不思議なお正月！？
rationale: Tsuki New Year comedy and ordinary-life motifs are retrieval-useful but low delta.

title: きょうえん！HTT＆HMA～放課後ティータイム＆星見アンバサダー～
rationale: K-On collaboration is primarily crossover/event texture with little uniquely necessary IDOLY PRIDE state evidence.

title: 心跳ねるクリスマスパーティー
rationale: GochiUsa Christmas collaboration is mostly crossover social texture without major native continuity leverage.

title: SOS！星見プロダクションの転送～ただのアイドルには興味ありません！？～
rationale: Haruhi crossover is analytically low priority for series-native claims.

title: ドタバタ！？トラブルクリスマス！
rationale: To Love-Ru crossover is low priority for series-native longitudinal claims.

title: ハロー！アイドル♪ 夢でつながるミラクルステージ
rationale: Sanrio crossover is primarily thematic/social material and carries a strong canon caveat.
